rows.title: The germinal products set asks for no county parish holding number and no permanent address
rows.detail: Germinal products are not kept on a holding and are never pets, so a germinal products notification is never asked for a county parish holding number or an animal's permanent address. The germinal set's consignment addresses page is copied from the live-animals one, which carries both sections, so the copy leaves them out and the set serves neither page.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification's consignment addresses page shows exactly five sections, in this order: "Place of origin", "Consignor", "Consignee", "Importer", "Place of destination". (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p9-024, prototype-dr2-1-source-p9-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, -p1-018, -p1-057)

Every link and button on a germinal products notification's pages opens one of that set's own steps, and none of them opens a county parish holding number page or a permanent address page; opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows "Page not found". (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-014, -p1-017, -p1-018, -p1-025; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-048, -p2-057, -p2-098, -p2-106)
rows.notes: One slice: both requirements are the same copied page leaving out a section and its page, so they share one set-up. They already sit in inc-181 with the germinal consignment addresses page and its pickers (consignment-parties area) and the germinal overview's Addresses task (notification-hub area); the combiner keeps them there. The two criteria are worded as inc-181 already carries them.

splitOff.why: It changes the plants consignment contact page's intro and sub-heading, in plantsfrontend:src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features/consignment-contact-select, which theme consignment-parties owns.

It changes the plants consignment contact page's save, return and amend controls, in plantsfrontend:src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features/consignment-contact-select, which theme consignment-parties owns.

It adds 'Remove CPH number' to the consignment addresses page's CPH section, in frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses (controller.js, copy, template.njk) and features/cph-number, which theme consignment-parties owns.

It adds 'Remove permanent address' to the consignment addresses page's Permanent address section, rendered from frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/controller.js and its copy, which theme consignment-parties owns.

It changes the permanent address page's layout and animal cards, in frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/permanent-address, which theme identification-and-permanent-address owns.
